item.title: Latest flare-up between US and Iran bring conflict's lull to an end
item.description: Iran's foreign minister has accused Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu of tricking the United States into war with the Islamic Republic. Over six months into the conflict, there appears to be no end in sight. This after the US struck sites in Iran, prompting Tehran to respond. An April ceasefire brought an end to intense fighting, but sporadic attacks have continued over the Strait of Hormuz. item.title: US military striking targets in Iran after attempted attacks on shipping
item.description: Iranian state media has reported that US strikes have killed 11 people in two separate attacks, including four at a wedding in the south of the country. This comes after the United States struck what it says were Iranian military targets Tuesday, as Tehran fired missiles and drones at sites across the Middle East, further escalating hostilities following a month-long lull. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

item.title: Netanyahu's wife shares conspiracy claim that opposition leader knew of Oct 7 attacks in advance
item.description: As Israel prepares for what are expected to be close-fought parliamentary elections in October, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's wife Sara on Monday shared a conspiracy theory that centre-left opposition figure Yair Golan had advance warning of the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attacks.

item.title: ישראל תופסת את מפקד חמאס בתקיפה בעזה, אמר שר הביטחון
item.description: ישראל כץ אומר שכוחות צה"ל תפסו את ראש הביטחון של חמאס מועין אל-ערביד במהלך פשיטה עמוקה בעזה, עם תקיפות אוויריות שכיסו את הנסיגה.

item.title: מבצע ישראלי בעזה הורג 4, אומרים גורמים פלסטינים
item.description: שר הביטחון של ישראל אמר כי המבצע הביא ללכידתו של בכיר חמאס. חמאס אמר כי ישראל שלחה פעילים חשאיים לתוך העיר עזה.

item.title: US launches more strikes on Iran as state media reports explosions
item.description: The Iranian Red Crescent says a child was among those killed when shrapnel from a US strike hit a home. The US military says it is aware of the reports and it never targets civilians.

item.title: Relentless heat worsens Gaza's ongoing struggle to access water
item.description: In Gaza, securing drinking water is a relentless daily struggle. The war with Israel has destroyed critical water and sanitation infrastructure, and as temperatures soar, the extreme heat is escalating an already severe shortage into a deadly humanitarian crisis. Two and a half years of war with Israel have damaged or destroyed nearly 90% of Gaza’s water and sanitation infrastructure according to UNICEF.

item.title: Iran, US trade fire in first exchange in a month
item.description: Iran attacked US military targets in the Middle East on Monday in retaliation following American strikes on an island in the Strait of Hormuz, the first exchange of fire for a month in a war that has engulfed the region.

item.title: Middle East war flares up after Iran responds to US attacks
item.description: Iran attacked US military targets in the Middle East in retaliation for the first American strikes on its territory in a month. This signs a fresh flare-up of the war that has engulfed the region. Washington said its attacks were aimed at preventing Iran from placing more sea mines in the strait and as it threatens new secondary economic sanctions. FRANCE 24's Reza Sayah is in Tehran and tells us more.

item.title: US embassies in Middle East warn Americans of 'unforeseen escalation' as latest strikes hit Iran
item.description: Multiple U.S. embassies warned Americans in the Middle East to "exercise caution and heightened vigilance," while CENTCOM launched fresh strikes on Iran.
